name: England
summary: Historical observation context used for the 1066 Halley's Comet case. The celestial event was not geographically confined to England; this place record represents the documentary and narrative observation context preserved in sources such as the Bayeux Tapestry.
uncertainty: Modern country normalization is used for repository geography; the 1066 political entity predates the modern United Kingdom.
The comet itself was a celestial object observable beyond this region.
